Even if I didn't mean it that way, the way it was said or the context could make it seem like I was being mean. So, is it right or wrong? I think it's a bit of both. On one hand, I didn't mean any harm, but on the other hand, the way it was said could be seen as disrespectful. It's a gray area. Maybe I should have been more considerate of his feelings, even though he wasn't a good teacher.
